summary: Wenatchee NF summit (Naneum Point), Chelan/Kittitas County, WA: a 1945 log crib cab, a 1958 40-foot tower; gone, with footings south of the communication tower.

facts.design: 8-foot log crib with a 12x12 frame live-in cab (1945), replaced in 1958 by a 40-foot wooden tower with a DNR live-in cab
facts.status_note: Abandoned in the late 1960s; the register says it is unclear when it was removed. Willhite found footings piled together south of the main communication tower.

access.note: Willhite drove the Naneum Ridge Road to the site. The road is rocky and potentially rutted; none of the sources read mention a closure or permit.

visit.trail_note: Drive up the Naneum Ridge Road, which is slow going, rocky and potentially rutted; most visitors Willhite saw were on ATV-type vehicles.

events.note: 8-foot log crib with a 12x12 frame live-in cab; a 1945 forestry report describes a new lookout at the head of Naneum Creek
40-foot wooden tower with a DNR live-in cab; Forest Lookouts lists a lookout completed in the 1956-58 biennium
Abandoned in the late 1960s; sources give only the decade, so the year is a placeholder
Registered in the Former Fire Lookout Sites register as US 1416, WA 316

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register lists the U.S. Forest Service as administrator. The Forest Lookouts page lists the State Forestry Division, and the 1958 tower carried a DNR cab. The story follows the register and notes the state listing.
The register and FireLookout.com give 6,623 feet (2,019 m); Willhite gives 6,629 feet. The story does not use an elevation.

notes_for_editor: No staffing source was found for Naneum Ridge, so no staffing fact is recorded. The brief's note that the site shares a register number is not confirmed; the cached register page gives US 1416, WA 316 for this site and I found no second site with that number. The 1960 abandonment year is a placeholder for the late 1960s. The public access level is inferred from no closure being mentioned.
